title: Remote job query
description: Filter current listings from public remote-job feeds.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Public feeds to query; no login or proxy is required.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Match any or all keywords in the normalized listing text.

keywordMatchMode.title: Keyword matching
keywordMatchMode.description: Use 'all' to require every keyword (the legacy default), or 'any' to match at least one.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Match a source location or location restriction.

maxAgeDays.title: Maximum age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Exclude listings older than this many days.

limit.title: Maximum results
limit.description: Maximum number of normalized records to return.

includeDescription.title: Include descriptions
includeDescription.description: Include cleaned job descriptions in each result.
